Dose.description: A dose as the coach edits it (dose.validate): loads in the gym's unit.
Dose.title: Dose

Entitlements.description: What the gym's plan allows now. Hide upgrade prompts while billing_enabled is false.
Entitlements.title: Entitlements

post.description:
Write the planned weeks. 409 if the chosen start isn't on offer any more (preview
again) or the weeks it would move have logged sessions.
What applying would add, week by week, and where it could go. Writes nothing.

get.description: What can be applied: the gym's templates and saved weeks.

post.description:
End the coaching link. The athlete keeps their history and account; they can join a
coach again through an invite.
Add an exercise to the day, with the dose the athlete last had for it.
Another session on the day (up to three).
The coach has seen the athlete's messages; clears the thread from their feed.

put.description: Set one metric (weights in the gym's unit, dated; height and years replace).

get.description:
This week at a glance, recent check-ins, lifetime PRs, the e1RM chart for `lift`
(default: the first tracked lift), and weekly volume and compliance.

post.description: Put the exercise at `index` in a session (any day of the same program).
Change the exercise, keeping the dose: one of the prescription's `swaps`.

get.description: The athlete's active program and one week of it: `week_id`, else this week.

post.description: Start a new block (the current one ends and is kept).
The athlete's whole program as a template.
Another week at the end, of the same type as the last.

get.description: Session bests above a working max, waiting for the coach: use it, or keep the max.

The gym's exercises to add, with this athlete's history: search by name, tag or
category, filter by every tag in `tags`; "recent" puts the last done first.

post.description: Email the athlete about their missing numbers (once a day at most).
Replace the athlete's questions with fresh copies of the gym's defaults.

get.description:
Logged sessions, newest first, a page at a time (audit H6): in the range ("4", "8"
weeks or "all"), optionally only those with an exercise matching `q`.
A short-lived link to watch the video (the coach's desktop plays it in the page).

post.description: Mark reviewed; feedback goes to the athlete as a message.

patch.description: Change the week's type, focus note or whether the athlete sees it (published).

post.description: Remove every session except logged days.
A copy right after the week (unpublished); later weeks move a week later.
A week of an athlete's program as a saved week.
Email a sign-in code. The same answer whether or not the email has an account.

Check the code: sign in to the email's account, or, for a new email, return a sign-up
ticket (valid 30 minutes) for coach sign-up or joining through an invite.

get.description: A one-time value for an Apple or Google sign-in (10 minutes).

post.description: New tokens for a refresh token (from the body, or the web app's cookie).
A new coach and their gym, for an email verified by `email/verify`.

get.description: The starter packs a new coach picks from (`starter` in signup/coach).

post.description:
Sign in with an identity token from Apple or Google. A new person gets a sign-up
ticket, as with an email code; the sign-in method is linked when they finish.
Add Apple or Google sign-in to the signed-in account (e.g. an Apple relay address).
A Stripe Checkout page to subscribe the gym (its owner only).
Stripe's Customer Portal: cards, invoices, changing or cancelling the plan.

Delete a category; its exercises move to `move_to_id` first (409 if it has some and
there's nowhere to go).

get.description: The check-in questions new athletes get (each athlete has their own copy).

The library, by category then name: search by name, tag, cue or category, and filter
by every tag given. `archived` lists the archived ones instead.

delete.description: Delete an archived exercise; logged sessions keep its name and sets.

get.description: What deleting it would remove or change, for the warning (archived exercises only).
The lifts this exercise's percentages could be worked from.
The attention feed, newest first. `next` is the cursor for the page after.

post.description:
A new invite. With an email the link is sent; `email_sent` false means it failed and
can be resent (the invite and its link still work).

get.description: What a new athlete can start on: the gym's templates and saved weeks.
What an invite link is for, before joining.

post.description: Join as the signed-in account (an athlete without a coach, or a new athlete profile).

Join as a new account, for an email verified by `auth/email/verify` (its ticket).
Answers with the new account's tokens, like signing in.

get.description:
The signed-in person and their profiles: a coach (with their gym), an athlete (with
their coach), or both. An athlete without a coach has `coach_name` null.

patch.description: Change one's own name or time zone (next to GET /me: one path, one router).

get.description: Sessions older than the phone's copy, a page at a time (online only).

put.description:
Hide training from before a coach's link from that coach (a new coach sees it all
by default).

post.description: Fill in numbers that are still missing (ones already there are left alone).
Start uploading a video of one exercise in the session (up to three each).

delete.description: Take a video back (until the coach has reviewed it).

post.description: The upload finished: the stored file is checked, then the coach is told.

Give every one of the coach's athletes fresh copies of the defaults (their old ones
are archived, so past answers keep their questions).

get.description:
The coach's athletes, sorted (attention, name, compliance, competition) and filtered
by name or email.
A new device's first copy of the athlete's scope (12 months of history).
What changed since `cursor` (from bootstrap or the last pull), a page at a time.

post.description: The athlete's actions, in the order they happened. Push before pulling.

get.description: The gym's templates, saved weeks and saved sessions (or one kind of them).
Saved weeks (kind "week") or saved sessions to drop into this template.

put.description: Change what the slot is (a fixed exercise, or tags with a default) and its dose.

post.description: Copy a saved week in as the last week, or a saved session into `template_week_id`.
A new last week: a copy of the previous one, percentages bumped by `points`.
A copy of this week as a saved week.

get.description: Lifts that could be added: active, measured in reps, not tracked yet.
The lifts the gym records maxes for, in order (up to six).
The gym's week types, active ones first in order, archived ones after.

post.description: Delete it, or archive it if weeks or templates use it (they keep it).
